statement: Move translates a selection with inference, axis lock via arrow keys or Shift, and typed distance or [global] and <relative> coordinates.
superiority: Move with a live numeric inspector and constraint solver for dependent geometry.

acceptance.sketch: Move a selected 10-face group by typed <1,2,3> m; all vertices shift exactly by that vector within 1e-12.

statement: Ctrl (Windows) or Option (Mac) toggles Copy; typing 5x or 5/ afterwards creates a linear array of copies or divides the displacement.
superiority: Arrays remain live and editable instead of baked copies.

acceptance.sketch: Copy by 2 m then type 4x: 4 copies at 2,4,6,8 m exactly.

statement: Dragging a face, edge or vertex of attached geometry stretches adjacent geometry and keeps faces planar.

source.ref: Move: stretch faces, edges and vertices

superiority: Stretch honors constraints such as fixed height and parallel edges.

acceptance.sketch: Drag a roof ridge vertex up by 1 m; adjacent faces remain planar within 1e-9.

statement: Alt or Command toggles Autofold, which creates crease edges to keep faces planar when a move would otherwise bend a face.
superiority: Optional automatic quad to triangle fold with visible fold control.

acceptance.sketch: Move a quad corner out of plane with Autofold on: face triangulated with a fold edge, all faces planar; off: free movement.

statement: Dragging the control edge of a surface entity (extruded arc, circle or polygon) resizes it without distortion.

source.ref: Move: control edge resizing of surface entities

superiority: Radius/length handles for every revolved or extruded surface.

acceptance.sketch: Drag control edge of a cylinder; the cylinder radius changes uniformly.

statement: Hover of a group or component shows corner, midpoint, side-center and center grips cycled with Alt or Command for picking pick-up points.

source.ref: Move: corner and center inference grips on components

superiority: Grips on oriented rather than axis-aligned bounds.

acceptance.sketch: Cycle grips on a box; grip positions equal bounding box points exactly.

statement: Hovering the Move tool over a face of a component shows rotation handles and a protractor to rotate without switching tools.
superiority: Consistent Gumball-like triad everywhere.

acceptance.sketch: Rotate a component 30 degrees using the handle; transformation equals closed form within 1e-12.

statement: Move tool in Stamp mode places repeated copies, and snap-equipped components attach snap to snap or snap to face with orientation.

source.ref: Move: stamp mode and snap attachment

superiority: Snaps carry named connection types and compatibility rules.

acceptance.sketch: Attach two snapped components; snap points coincide within 1e-9 and orientations match.

statement: Rotate uses a protractor to rotate a selection about a point and axis, with typed angle or slope, copy mode and multiple copies by Ctrl and typed count.
superiority: Angle snap increments configurable, and a 3D gizmo option.

acceptance.sketch: Rotate a component 37.5 degrees about a vertical axis; matrix equals closed form within 1e-12.

statement: Rotate can fold a face or group of faces along a drag-defined hinge edge, bending adjacent geometry.

source.ref: Rotate: fold geometry along an axis

superiority: Fold keeps connected faces stretched correctly with a preview.

acceptance.sketch: Fold a flap by 90 degrees about an edge; folded face normal equals the rotated normal.

statement: Arrow keys choose rotation plane, Shift locks it, Alt or Command frees the protractor from the inferenced plane.

source.ref: Rotate: protractor plane lock and free protractor

superiority: Clear on-screen plane indicator and keyboard-only operation.

acceptance.sketch: Lock plane with Shift while moving cursor; the rotation axis remains the locked normal.

statement: Rotate shows corner grips for groups and components, cycled with Alt or Command, and rotation respects component axes.

source.ref: Rotate: corner inference grips and Move-tool rotation

superiority: Pivot manipulation without leaving the tool.

acceptance.sketch: Rotate a component by corner grip; pivot equals the corner point exactly.

statement: Scale tool scales uniformly from corner grips, in two axes from edge grips and one axis from face grips, with scale-from-center toggle by Ctrl or Option and uniform toggle by Shift.

source.ref: Scale: corner, edge and face grips

superiority: Non-uniform scale of groups keeps components' true size via a clear skew warning.

acceptance.sketch: Scale a box 150 percent uniformly then 50 percent on the red axis only; vertex coordinates equal closed form within 1e-12.

statement: Measurements box accepts scale factors, percent, absolute lengths and comma-separated per-axis values during scaling.

source.ref: Scale: typed values (percent, factor, lengths, per-axis)

superiority: Unit-aware expressions and linking of axes.

acceptance.sketch: Type 2,1,0.5 on a box; extents equal 2x,1x,0.5x.

statement: Scale tool places and sizes Live Components using inferenced grips.

source.ref: Scale: Live Component grips and placement by inference

superiority: Live components expose declared resize rules with limits.

acceptance.sketch: Place a Live Component by two inferred grips; result extents equal the grips' distances exactly.

statement: Components can reset scale and reset skew from the context menu.

source.ref: Scale: reset scale and reset skew

superiority: Preview of the reset effect.

acceptance.sketch: Reset skew on a skewed instance; transformation becomes orthonormal with unit scale preserved.

statement: Flip mirrors selected geometry about adjustable planes, with Copy mode, Axes mode, custom magenta flip plane from a hovered face, and arrow keys to choose the plane.
superiority: Mirrored copies stay linked to the source.

acceptance.sketch: Mirror a component about a plane at distance 1 m; reflection matrix has determinant -1 and positions match closed form within 1e-12.

statement: Context-click a component to Flip Along its red, green or blue axis.
superiority: One-step mirror with a defined pivot option.

acceptance.sketch: Flip along each axis; component transformation negates that axis exactly.

statement: Push/Pull extrudes or cuts a face along its normal with typed distance, double-click to repeat the last distance, Ctrl to leave the original face, and parallel-face inference.
superiority: Push/Pull works on curved and NURBS faces with correct trimming and keeps history editable.

acceptance.sketch: Pull a 1 m by 1 m face 2 m; resulting solid volume 2.0 m3 exact, 6 faces.

statement: Pushing a face onto the opposite parallel face cuts through; the offset limit is reported, and extra lines on the opposite face block through-cut.
superiority: Guarantees manifold topology after cut.

acceptance.sketch: Push a hole through a slab to a parallel face; resulting solid has an open hole with correct topology.

statement: Push/Pulling a curved face creates a surface entity made of many smaller faces.

source.ref: Push/Pull: curved faces and surface entities

superiority: Extrude yields a single true cylinder.

acceptance.sketch: Extrude a 24-gon face; resulting prism has 24 side faces and smooth normals.

statement: Double-click another face to apply the previous distance; Ctrl double-click stacks an identical extrusion.

source.ref: Push/Pull: duplicate extrusion with double click and Ctrl+double-click

superiority: Multi-face extrude with per-face distances shown.

acceptance.sketch: Repeat extrusions on 3 faces; each extrudes by the same distance exactly.

statement: Edges are visible through thin extrusions below about 2.54 cm; the manual recommends hiding the edges.
superiority: Robust rendering of thin features without visual workarounds.

acceptance.sketch: Render a 1 mm slab; no z-fighting artifacts.

statement: Follow Me drags a face along a path of edges, highlighting the path in red; used for moldings, gutters and lathes.
superiority: Follow Me with mitre control, twist and scale along path.

acceptance.sketch: Extrude a 5 cm square profile along an L-path; solid volume equals profile area times path length (with mitre) within 1e-9.

statement: Pre-selecting a continuous edge path then Follow Me and clicking the profile extrudes automatically; profile needn't touch the path but must be perpendicular.

source.ref: Follow Me: automatic extrusion with pre-selected path

superiority: Profile need not be perpendicular; auto-orient to path frames.

acceptance.sketch: Preselect a 4-edge rectangular path; extrusion volume equals area times perimeter within 1e-9 (with mitre corrections).

statement: Follow Me with a circle path lathes a half-profile into a solid of revolution.

source.ref: Follow Me: lathe around a circle

superiority: Exact revolution surface instead of faceted.

acceptance.sketch: Revolve a 1x1 profile at radius 2; volume equals Pappus value within segment tolerance.

statement: Procedural Follow Me produces a non-destructive procedural component whose path and profile can be re-edited later.
superiority: Procedures are inspectable graphs that can be exposed as parameters.

acceptance.sketch: Edit the profile after creation; the extruded component updates and path stays intact.

statement: Offset creates an equidistant copy of selected coplanar edges or a face with typed distance, with overlap removal by default and Alt or Command to allow overlap; double-click repeats offset.
superiority: Offset of curves with true arcs preserved and 3D offset of solids.

acceptance.sketch: Offset a 4 m by 3 m rectangle by 0.2 m inward: inner rectangle 3.6 by 2.6 exactly.

statement: Offsetting an arc creates a curve entity unless it has three or more segments; arc entity is preserved for circular arcs.
superiority: Offset any curve exactly.

acceptance.sketch: Offset a 12-segment arc; arc entity remains with radius +/- d.

statement: Explode dissolves groups, components, curves and images into their parts in the parent context.
superiority: Explode preserves attributes in a named reference.

acceptance.sketch: Explode a component with 40 faces; 40 faces appear in parent, instance removed, transformation applied.

statement: Context-click selection > Intersect Faces > With Model/Selection/Context creates cut edges.
superiority: Same plus a union option.

acceptance.sketch: Two overlapping boxes; the intersection edge count matches analytic result.

statement: Typed Nx after Rotate creates N circular copies at equal angles.
superiority: Polar arrays are live with count and angle parameters.

acceptance.sketch: Rotate copy 30 degrees then 11x: 12 copies spaced at 30 degrees, closure within 1e-12.

statement: Position Texture (Fixed Pins) moves, scales, rotates, shears and distorts a texture on a face with pins; Projected texturing for curved surfaces.
superiority: Texture projection edits stay editable per face.

acceptance.sketch: Pin a texture to four corners; UVs of those corners equal the pins within 1e-6.

statement: Texture projection and Make Unique Texture create per-instance textures and projected texture coordinates.
superiority: Full UV editor with unwrap tools.

acceptance.sketch: Project a texture on a curved wall; UV continuity across adjacent faces within 1e-6.

statement: Double-click enters a group or component edit context; the rest of the model is dimmed or hidden according to model info.

source.ref: Edit context for groups and components

superiority: Breadcrumbs and a one-key exit to root.

acceptance.sketch: Enter edit context on nested group; edits affect only that definition, parent geometry remains untouched.

statement: Entity Info shows type, tag, material, name, size, area, solid status, and lets you edit attributes of selection.

source.ref: Entity Info panel (inspect and edit entity properties)

superiority: Batch edit with expression fields.

acceptance.sketch: Select a face; area reading equals computed area; edit tag; undo restores.

statement: Model Info holds units, dimensions style, text, statistics (purge unused), components display, credits, file info and animation.

source.ref: Model Info settings (units, text, dimensions, statistics, components)

superiority: Statistics with drill-down to offending entities.

acceptance.sketch: Switch to architectural units; displayed lengths convert exactly; Statistics shows counts equal to model data.

statement: Purge Unused removes unused components, materials, styles and tags; Fix Problems repairs model errors.
superiority: Dry-run purge listing with undo.

acceptance.sketch: After purge, orphan definition counts are zero and the file size shrinks.

statement: Selectable unit formats with precision, snap, and format display, and typed unit overrides in the Measurements box.

source.ref: Units: architectural, decimal, engineering, fractional, angular precision

superiority: Mixed unit input with unit-safe expressions.

acceptance.sketch: Type 3' 6" in metric template; value equals 1.0668 m exactly.
